news.n_mng_khabul: The old men remember Khabul Khan, the first khan of all the Mongols: they say that at a feast with the Jin emperor he tugged the emperor's beard - and got away alive.
news.n_mng_ambaghai: They say the Tatars handed Ambaghai Khan over to the Jurchens, who nailed him to a wooden donkey. Before he died he commanded vengeance.
news.n_mng_song_jin: They say the Jurchens have moved the capital of their Jin empire to Zhongdu, beyond the Great Wall, closer to the Chinese lands.
news.n_mng_jerusalem: Merchants from the west tell that the Franks hold the distant city of Jerusalem and fight the Muslims for it.
news.n_mng_sanjar: Word has come from beyond the Tian Shan: Sultan Sanjar, the last great Seljuk, is dead. Khorasan is left without a master.
news.n_mng_hotula: The Mongols have chosen the hero Khutula as khan. They say his voice was like thunder and his hands like a bear's paws.
news.n_mng_kiev_mongols: Merchants say that far to the west, in the forests, there is a rich city of the Urus called Kiev, with golden roofs on its temples.
news.n_mng_caishi: They say that on the Yangtze the southern Chinese fleet routed the Jin emperor's army with fire missiles, and the emperor himself was killed by his own men.
news.n_mng_temujin_born: On the Onon a son has been born in the yurt of Yesügei the Brave. They say he clutched in his little fist a clot of blood like a stone - the sign of a future warrior.
news.n_mng_kara_khitai: Merchants from the Seven Rivers tell of the kingdom of the Kara Khitai: their gurkhan rules Muslims but prays in the Chinese way himself.
news.n_mng_kereit: They say the Kereits have a new khan - Toghrul. He is a Christian, and crosses hang even over the door of his yurt.
news.n_mng_tatars_jin: They say the Jurchens pay the Tatars in silk to make war on the Mongols. They profit more from a divided steppe.
news.n_mng_yesugei_poison: Terrible news from the Onon: the Tatars poisoned Yesügei the Brave at a feast. His widow Hö'elün and her children have been abandoned by their own people.
news.n_mng_saladin: From the west they say a Kurd, Salah al-Din, now rules Egypt and Syria and is gathering his strength against the Franks.
news.n_mng_naimans: The Naimans in the Altai are rich: their khan has a seal and Uyghur scribes, and they laugh at the Mongols who "smell of smoke".
news.n_mng_temujin_captive: They say the Tayichi'ud held young Temüjin in a cangue, but he escaped by night, lying in the river, and a simple man, Sorkhan Shira, hid him.
news.n_mng_japan_genpei: From the far east, beyond the sea, they say that in the islands of Japan two warrior houses, the white and the red, are at war.
news.n_mng_begter: They say young Temüjin shot his half-brother Begter over a fish and a lark. Their mother Hö'elün cursed them both for a long time.
news.n_mng_borte: They say the Merkits carried off Börte, Temüjin's wife, and that he won her back with the help of his anda Jamukha and Toghrul Khan.
news.n_mng_song_south: Merchants from the south say there are more people in Hangzhou, capital of the southern Chinese, than on the whole steppe.
news.n_mng_jerusalem_fall: Merchants say Salah al-Din has taken Jerusalem from the Franks, and now the armies of all the Frankish kings are marching against him.
news.n_mng_temujin_khan: They say the nearer clans have chosen Temüjin as their khan. But the old chiefs laugh: what sort of khan can an orphan make?
news.n_mng_kamakura: They say that in Japan the warrior chief Minamoto has received the title of shogun and rules the country from Kamakura.
news.n_mng_yellow_river: Word comes from China: the Yellow River has burst its dykes and carved a new course, drowning hundreds of villages.
news.n_mng_merkits: The Merkits beyond the Selenga are raiding their neighbours again. Their chief Toqto'a Beki acknowledges no one's authority.
news.n_mng_khwarazm_rise: Merchants from Khwarazm boast that their shah Tekish has beaten the Seljuks, and now Khwarazm is the strongest power in the west.
news.n_mng_richard: From the west they say the Frankish king Richard the Lionheart, who fought Salah al-Din, has died.
news.n_mng_jamukha_gurkhan: They say Temüjin's enemies have gathered at a kurultai and proclaimed Jamukha gurkhan - khan of all khans.
news.n_mng_tatars_end: They say Temüjin has finally crushed the Tatars at Dalan Nemürges and put to death all their men taller than a cart's axle.
news.n_mng_constantinople: Astonishing rumours come from the west: the Franks who set out to fight for Jerusalem have taken and sacked Christian Constantinople.
news.n_mng_jamukha_death: They say Jamukha was handed over by his own nökers. He asked only one thing - to be put to death without his blood being shed - and the khan granted it.
news.n_mng_delhi_sultanate: Merchants from India say a former slave, Aibak, has become sultan of Delhi.
news.n_mng_forest_peoples: They say the khan's eldest son, Jochi, has subdued the forest peoples beyond Baikal - the Oirats, the Kyrgyz, the Buryats.
news.n_mng_uyghurs: The Uyghur idiqut Barchuq has come to the khan of his own accord and called himself his fifth son. The Uyghurs have submitted without a fight.
news.n_mng_karluks: They say the Qarluqs of the Seven Rivers have come to the khan too, seeking protection from the Kara Khitai.
news.n_mng_children: Merchants from the west tell a strange tale: thousands of Frankish children set out to free Jerusalem, and were sold into slavery.
news.n_mng_magna_carta: Merchants from the far west say the nobles of the island of England have forced their king to sign a charter of liberties.
news.n_mng_subutai_merkits: They say Sübe'etei, with iron-shod wagons, has reached the Irgiz and finished off the last of the Merkits.
news.n_mng_kara_khitai_fall: Jebe has defeated the Naiman prince Küchlüg, who had seized the kingdom of the Kara Khitai. The Muslims of Kashgar greeted the Mongols as liberators.
news.n_mng_otrar_news: At Otrar the Khwarazmshah's governor has massacred the khan's caravan - four hundred and fifty merchants. The khan prayed on a mountain for three days.
news.n_mng_bukhara: They say the khan rode into Bukhara and said from the pulpit of the mosque: "I am the punishment of God. If you had not committed great sins, God would not have sent me upon you."
news.n_mng_jalal: They say the Khwarazmshah's son Jalal al-Din leapt into the Indus on his horse from a high bank, and the khan, watching him go, said: "That is the kind of son a father should have."
news.n_mng_changchun: The Daoist sage Changchun has come from China to the khan in the Hindu Kush. The khan asked him for the elixir of immortality, and the old man replied: there are ways to preserve life, but there is no elixir.
news.n_mng_muqali: In China Mukhali has died, the "prince of the state", to whom the khan had entrusted the whole war against the Jin.
news.n_mng_jochi: They say the khan's eldest son Jochi roams the distant west, in the Kipchak steppes, and will not come to his father. There is coldness between them.
news.n_mng_xixia_end: The Tangut kingdom of Xi Xia has been destroyed: the city taken, the people slaughtered. They say it was the khan's last wish.
news.n_mng_ogedei: At the kurultai on the Kherlen, Chinggis's third son Ögedei - cheerful and generous - has been elected khan.
news.n_mng_yelu: They say the Khitan adviser Yelü Chucai has persuaded the khan not to turn China's fields into pastures: living peasants pay more taxes than dead ones.
news.n_mng_korea: They say the Korean court has fled from the Mongols to the island of Ganghwa and sits there across the strait.
news.n_mng_jin_fall: The Jin empire has fallen: its last emperor, besieged in Caizhou, handed over the throne and took his own life.
news.n_mng_samarkand_return: They say there is trade in Samarkand again: the city, half-empty after the war, is slowly reviving under the khan's darughachis.
news.n_mng_bulgar: Batu's tümens have taken the Great City of the Volga Bulgars. Merchants from there are fleeing to Rus.
news.n_mng_kozelsk: They say the little Russian town of Kozelsk held out against Batu for seven weeks. The khan ordered it to be called "the wicked city".
news.n_mng_kiev: Kiev, the ancient capital of the Urus, has been taken and burned. They say only a handful of its hundreds of churches survived.
news.n_mng_ogedei_death_news: Khan Ögedei has died - they say after a night of drinking. His widow Töregene rules.
news.n_mng_ice_battle: Word comes from Rus: Prince Alexander of Novgorod has beaten the German knights on the ice of a lake.
news.n_mng_kose_dag: They say Baiju's tümen has defeated the Seljuk sultan of Rum at Köse Dağ, and Anatolia now pays tribute.
news.n_mng_jerusalem_khwarazm: Remnants of the Khwarazmian army, fleeing west from the Mongols, have taken and ravaged Jerusalem.
news.n_mng_guyuk: At the kurultai Güyük, son of Ögedei, has been elected khan. A friar sent by the Pope of Rome himself was present at the enthronement.
news.n_mng_yaroslav: They say the Russian grand prince Yaroslav died after dining with the khatun Töregene in Karakorum. People whisper of poison.
news.n_mng_carpini_home: They say the friar Plano Carpini, who visited Güyük, has returned to the Pope and is writing how to wage war on the Mongols.
news.n_mng_guyuk_death: Khan Güyük has died on the road west - they say he was marching to war against his cousin Batu.
news.n_mng_louis: They say the Frankish king Louis has been taken prisoner by the Egyptian Mamluks and ransomed for a huge sum.
news.n_mng_oghul: The regent Oghul Qaimish, widow of Güyük, has been executed: she was accused of sorcery against Möngke.
news.n_mng_sorghaghtani: Sorghaghtani Beki has died - the mother of Möngke, Khubilai and Hülegü. They say there was no wiser woman in the whole empire.
news.n_mng_nevsky: Batu has granted Alexander Nevsky the patent of grand prince of Vladimir. He had travelled to Sarai and to Karakorum.
news.n_mng_dali: Khubilai has conquered the mountain kingdom of Dali in south-west China, outflanking the Song from the rear.
news.n_mng_batu_death: Batu, khan of the Ulus of Jochi, has died. The Russians call him Batyi and will remember him long.
news.n_mng_alamut: Hülegü has taken Alamut - the mountain fortress of the Ismaili Assassins, whom every ruler of the East feared.
news.n_mng_berke_islam: The new khan of the Ulus of Jochi, Berke, is a Muslim. They say he is the first of the Chinggisids to have embraced Islam.
news.n_mng_baghdad_news: Hülegü has taken Baghdad, and the caliph, they say, was rolled in a carpet and trampled by horses - so as not to spill royal blood.
news.n_mng_mongke_death: Khan Möngke has died beneath the walls of the Chinese fortress of Diaoyucheng - whether of sickness or of a wound, no one is sure.
news.n_mng_aleppo: Hülegü's tümens have taken Aleppo and Damascus. They say the Christians of Damascus walked the streets carrying crosses.
news.n_mng_byzantium_back: From the west they say the Greeks have won Constantinople back from the Franks, and there is a Greek emperor in the city once more.
news.n_mng_nevsky_death: Returning from the Horde, Prince Alexander Nevsky has died. The Urus mourn him as their protector.
news.n_mng_ariq_surrender: Ariq Böke has surrendered to his brother Khubilai. They say Khubilai asked: "Which of us was right?" - and his brother answered: "Then it was I; now it is you."
news.n_mng_hulegu_death: The Ilkhan Hülegü has died, and soon after him his Christian wife Doquz Khatun. The Nestorians of Iran are anxious.
news.n_mng_berke_death: Khan Berke has died on campaign towards Tiflis, at war with the Ilkhans. He has been succeeded by Möngke Temür.
news.n_mng_phagpa: The lama Phagpa has created a new "square" script for the empire, in which Mongol, Chinese and Tibetan can all be written.
news.n_mng_talas: On the Talas the descendants of Chagatai, Ögedei and Jochi have made peace among themselves - against Khubilai.
news.n_mng_polo_set_out: They say the Polo merchants have set out from Venice for Khan Khubilai - for the second time - taking young Marco with them.
news.n_mng_japan1274: They say Khubilai's first campaign against Japan has failed: a storm scattered the fleet off Hakata.
news.n_mng_hangzhou: The Yuan general Bayan has entered Hangzhou, capital of the Southern Song, without a fight. The empress regent has surrendered the seal.
news.n_mng_baybars: In Egypt Sultan Baybars, the victor of Ain Jalut, has died. The Mamluks remain the Ilkhans' enemies.
news.n_mng_yamen: In the sea battle off Yamen the last Song ships have been lost. They say a minister leapt into the sea with the little emperor in his arms.
news.n_mng_homs: At Homs in Syria the Ilkhan's army has again been beaten by the Mamluks.
news.n_mng_ahmad: In Khanbaliq the all-powerful finance minister Ahmad has been murdered. The khan first mourned him, then ordered him dug up and thrown to the dogs.
news.n_mng_vietnam: They say Khubilai's army has been beaten again in the land of Dai Viet: the people strike from the jungle and fall back into the marshes.
news.n_mng_chabi_death: There is mourning at Khubilai's court: the khan's beloved wife Chabi, his counsellor in all things, has died.
news.n_mng_nayan: The Christian prince Nayan has rebelled against Khubilai. The khan, old as he is, rode into battle himself on an elephant and crushed him.
news.n_mng_sauma: They say the Uyghur monk Rabban Sauma has travelled as the Ilkhan's envoy to the kings of the Franks and to the Pope of Rome.
news.n_mng_tula_ulus: They say that in the Ulus of Chagatai the khans have moved from the steppe into the towns and pray more and more in mosques.
news.n_mng_acre: From the west they say the Mamluks have taken Acre, the last city of the Franks in the Holy Land.
news.n_mng_java: Khubilai's fleet has sailed for the distant island of Java to punish its king, who insulted the khan's envoy.
news.n_mng_khubilai_death: The Great Khan Khubilai has died at eighty. The Yuan throne has passed to his grandson Temür.
news.n_mng_polo_home: They say the Venetian Polos have come home from China after twenty-four years. No one believes them.
news.n_mng_ghazan_reforms: The Ilkhan Ghazan and the vizier Rashid al-Din are rewriting the taxes: relief for the peasants of Iran after so many years of ruin.
news.n_mng_nogai: In the Horde the commander Nogai, who for twenty years made and unmade khans, has been killed. Khan Tokhta struck him down.
news.n_mng_osman: They say that in Anatolia a bey named Osman is gathering men and fighting the Greeks. Few have heard of him.
news.n_mng_khaidu: Khaidu, grandson of Ögedei, who for thirty years made war on Khubilai and his heirs, has died.
news.n_mng_marj: Near Damascus the Mamluks have routed the army of the Ilkhan Ghazan. The Ilkhans will march on Syria no more.
news.n_mng_peace: The uluses have made peace: the Yuan, the Chagatayids, the Horde and the Ilkhans have recognised the primacy of the Great Khan in Khanbaliq.
news.n_mng_montecorvino: They say that in Khanbaliq the Frankish friar John of Montecorvino has built a church and is baptising children.
news.n_mng_sultaniyya: The Ilkhan Öljeitü is building a new capital, Sultaniyya, with a dome higher than any the world has seen.
news.n_mng_mansa_musa: Merchants from Cairo tell of the black king of Mali who is travelling to Mecca with a caravan of gold.
news.n_mng_exams: The Yuan court has held examinations for office for the first time - with different questions for Mongols and for Chinese.
news.n_mng_mikhail: In the Horde Prince Mikhail of Tver has been put to death - slandered by Prince Yuri of Moscow.
news.n_mng_odoric: They say the Frankish friar Odoric has travelled through India and the islands to Khanbaliq and is living by Montecorvino's cathedral.
news.n_mng_shidebala: In Khanbaliq conspirators have murdered the young emperor Shidebala in his camp. The court is in turmoil.
news.n_mng_ibn_battuta_set: They say a young qadi named Ibn Battuta has left Tangier for Mecca - and has no intention of going home.
news.n_mng_war_two_capitals: After the emperor's death the court has split: Shangdu and Dadu have each enthroned a khan of their own and are at war.
news.n_mng_kalita: Prince Ivan Kalita of Moscow has received the patent for the whole grand principality and now gathers the tribute for the Horde himself.
news.n_mng_abusaid: The Ilkhan Abu Sa'id has died without a son. The realm of the Hülegüids is falling apart.
news.n_mng_vijayanagar: Merchants from India tell of a new kingdom in the south - Vijayanagara, with enormous temples.
news.n_mng_issyk_kul: From the Seven Rivers they say there is a pestilence among the Nestorian communities by Issyk-Kul - whole families are being buried.
news.n_mng_toghto: In Khanbaliq the minister Toghto has driven out the corrupt grandees and ordered histories of the Liao, Jin and Song to be written.
news.n_mng_janibek: Janibek, son of Özbeg, has become khan of the Horde. They say he killed two brothers to take the throne.
news.n_mng_tana: At Tana on the Don the Venetians have been attacked, and Khan Janibek has gone to war against the Italian trading posts in the Crimea.
news.n_mng_chagatai_split: The Ulus of Chagatai has split: in the west the emirs rule, in the east the khans of Moghulistan.
news.n_mng_europe_plague: Black news comes from the west: the pestilence that came out of Caffa is ravaging the Frankish cities - they say one in three has died.
news.n_mng_yellow_dykes: In China a hundred and fifty thousand men have been rounded up to repair the Yellow River dykes. The officials fear a revolt.
news.n_mng_toghto_fall: The minister Toghto has been exiled, though he had almost crushed the rebels. The army has scattered, and the revolt has flared up again.
news.n_mng_janibek_death: Khan Janibek has died after returning from his campaign against Tabriz. People whisper that his son Berdibek strangled him.
news.n_mng_troubles: Three khans have come and gone in Sarai in a single year. The merchants say no road in the Horde is safe any more.
news.n_mng_zhu: They say the rebel Zhu Yuanzhang has destroyed his rival's fleet on Lake Poyang and become master of southern China.
news.n_mng_red_shangdu: They say bands of Red Turbans reached Shangdu and burned the khans' summer capital.
news.n_mng_ming: In the south Zhu Yuanzhang has proclaimed a new dynasty - the Ming, the "Bright". He promises to drive out the Mongols.
news.n_mng_toghon_death: At Yingchang, on the steppe, the last Yuan emperor Toghon Temür has died. His son Ayushiridara has fallen back to Karakorum.
news.n_mng_timur_rise: From Transoxiana they say the lame emir Timur has taken Balkh and become master of the Ulus of Chagatai, though he is no Chinggisid himself.
news.n_mng_tula: They say that by the Tuul river Köke Temür's Mongols have routed a great Ming army. The steppe can still defend itself.
news.n_mng_koke: Köke Temür, the finest general of the Northern Yuan, has died. They say even the Ming emperor regretted that he could never win him over.
news.n_mng_tokhtamysh_rise: Prince Tokhtamysh, with Timur's help, has come from beyond the Syr Darya to win the throne of the Horde.
news.n_mng_vozha: News from Rus: on the river Vozha Prince Dmitry of Moscow has for the first time defeated a Horde army, that of the mirza Begich.
news.n_mng_karakorum_fire: Ming troops have reached Karakorum and burned it. The old city of the khans lies in ashes.
news.n_mng_tokhtamysh_tabriz: Khan Tokhtamysh has gone through Derbent and sacked Tabriz. Timur is furious: he regarded Tabriz as his own prey.
news.n_mng_buir: At Lake Buir a Ming general has taken tens of thousands of Mongols prisoner. Khan Tögüs Temür fled and was soon killed by his own people.
news.n_mng_kondurcha: Timur has crossed the whole steppe with a huge army and defeated Tokhtamysh on the river Kondurcha.
news.n_mng_joseon: From Korea they say the dynasty has changed; the new kingdom is called Joseon, and it is friendly with the Ming.
news.n_mng_yelets: Timur has reached the Russian town of Yelets and turned back. The Urus say a wonder-working icon protected them.
news.n_mng_delhi: They say Timur has reached India and taken Delhi. From there he is leading away elephants and thousands of craftsmen.
news.n_mng_vorskla: On the river Vorskla Edigu has defeated the Lithuanian prince Vytautas, who had meant to put Tokhtamysh back on the throne.
news.n_mng_ankara: Timur has defeated the Ottoman sultan Bayezid near Ankara and taken him prisoner.
news.n_mng_oirat_rise: The Oirats in the west are ever stronger: their taishi Mahmud does not recognise the khan of the eastern Mongols.
news.n_mng_timur_death: Timur has died at Otrar on his way to China. They say he meant to give the world back to Chinggisid rule.
news.n_mng_zheng_he: They say the Ming emperor has sent the eunuch Zheng He with an enormous fleet into the southern seas - as far as India and Arabia.
news.n_mng_edigei_moscow: Edigu has suddenly appeared before Moscow; he could not take it, but he took a huge ransom.
news.n_mng_yongle: The Ming emperor Yongle is leading an army into the steppe himself, against Khan Bunyashiri. The Mongols are moving off beyond the Onon.
news.n_mng_grunwald: From the west they say the Poles and Lithuanians, with Tatar cavalry, have defeated the order of German knights.
news.n_mng_arughtai: They say the Asud taishi Arughtai is at war with the Oirats, while the Ming court helps first one side, then the other.
news.n_mng_edigei_death: Edigu, who ruled the Horde for twenty years in the khans' name, has been killed. His sons will become leaders of the Nogais.
news.n_mng_beijing: The Ming emperor has moved his capital to Beijing - on the site of Khanbaliq - and built the Forbidden City there.
news.n_mng_yongle_death: The emperor Yongle has died returning from his fifth campaign into the steppe. The Mongols breathe more freely.
news.n_mng_uzbeks: In the steppes beyond the Yaik the nomads of Khan Abu'l-Khayr call themselves Uzbeks.
news.n_mng_arughtai_death: The Oirat Toghon Taishi has killed Arughtai. Now the whole steppe is in Oirat hands.
news.n_mng_kazan: Khan Ulugh Muhammad, driven out of the Horde, has settled on the Volga and founded the Khanate of Kazan.
news.n_mng_crimea: In the Crimea Hajji Giray has proclaimed himself khan. Another ulus has broken away from the Horde.
news.n_mng_esen_hami: Esen Taishi has subdued Hami and the Uyghur oases. Caravans from the west come to him for passage.
news.n_mng_vasily_captive: They say the princes of Kazan have defeated and captured Prince Vasily of Moscow and released him for a huge ransom.
news.n_mng_kasimov: The Prince of Moscow has given the Tatar prince Kasim a little town on the Oka. There is now a small khanate there in Moscow's service.
news.n_mng_constantinople_fall: News from the west: the Ottoman Turks have taken Constantinople. The last Greek emperor died on the walls.
news.n_mng_esen_death: Esen the Oirat, who called himself khan, has been killed. The Chinggisids did not forgive him for not being of their lineage.
news.n_mng_kazakh: They say the sultans Kerei and Janibek have led their people away from the Uzbeks into the Seven Rivers. They are called Kazakhs - the free ones.
news.n_mng_ottoman_crimea: They say the Ottoman sultan is building a fleet, and the Genoese in Caffa are trembling for their walls.
news.n_mng_beg_arslan: The steppe is without a khan again: the taishis and begs put young Chinggisids on the throne and kill them as soon as they grow up.
news.n_mng_manduul_death: Khan Manduul has died without a son. His widow Mandukhai has refused every noyan who sought her hand.
news.n_mng_caffa: The Turks have taken Genoese Caffa in the Crimea, and the Crimean khan has become the sultan's vassal.
news.n_mng_ugra_news: News from the west, from the Ugra: Khan Akhmat has withdrawn from the Muscovite regiments without giving battle. Moscow pays no more.
news.n_mng_akhmat_death: Akhmat, khan of the Great Horde, has been killed in his yurt by Ibak, khan of Sibir.
news.n_mng_dayan_young: They say the young Batmönkh has been proclaimed Dayan Khan - "khan of all". For now Mandukhai rules for him.
news.n_mng_kazan_moscow: Moscow has taken Kazan and placed its own khan there. They say the Urus now choose khans themselves.
news.n_mng_columbus: Merchants from the west tell a tall tale: a Genoese in the service of the Spaniards has sailed across the ocean and found land there.
news.n_mng_portuguese: Merchants say the Frankish Portuguese have sailed to India round Africa, bypassing the Turks.
news.n_mng_shaybani: The Uzbeks of Khan Shaybani have taken Samarkand, and the descendants of Timur are fleeing south.
news.n_mng_horde_end_news: The Crimean khan has crushed the last khan of the Great Horde. Sarai has been burned; nothing remains of the Golden Horde.
news.n_mng_safavids: They say that in Iran the young Shah Ismail has gathered the Qizilbash and proclaimed Shi'ism the faith of his realm.
news.n_mng_ming_wall: The Ming authorities are building a new wall along the whole steppe frontier - of brick and stone, with towers every half verst.
news.n_mng_shaybani_death: Shaybani Khan has been killed in battle with Shah Ismail. They say the shah made a drinking cup of his skull.
news.n_mng_chaldiran: The Ottomans have beaten Shah Ismail at Chaldiran with cannon, and Tabriz has briefly fallen into the sultan's hands.
news.n_mng_cairo: The Ottoman sultan Selim has taken Cairo, and the last caliph has gone with him to Istanbul.
news.n_mng_crimea_moscow: The Crimean khan Mehmed Giray has reached Moscow itself. The prince fled, and the khan was given a charter promising tribute.
news.n_mng_babur: They say Babur, a descendant of Timur and of Chinggis, has conquered India. There they call him the Great Mughal - that is, the Mongol.
news.n_mng_vienna: From the west they say the Turks besieged Vienna, a German city, but winter forced them to withdraw.
news.n_mng_bodi: Bodi Alagh Khan, Dayan's grandson, rules the six tümens from the Chakhar camp. His younger kinsmen obey him reluctantly.
news.n_mng_darayisun: They say the Great Khan Darayisun has gone east with the Chakhars to the Liao rivers - away from the powerful Altan Khan.
news.n_mng_altan_ordos: They say Altan Khan of the Tümed is stronger than the Great Khan and is demanding that the Ming open the markets.
news.n_mng_tsar: Ivan of Moscow has been crowned tsar. The Urus call him tsar, as they once called the khans.
news.n_mng_kazan_fall: Tsar Ivan of Moscow has taken Kazan by storm. The Khanate of Kazan has fallen.
news.n_mng_astrakhan: Tsar Ivan has taken Astrakhan too. Now the whole Volga, from its source to the Caspian, is Russian.
news.n_mng_tsogt: They say Japanese pirates are raiding China from the sea, and the Ming armies do not know what to do with them or with the Mongols.
news.n_mng_fireguns: The Chinese musketeers on the wall fire so hard that the tümens no longer charge head-on. The Mongols are buying firearms from merchants.
news.n_mng_hohhot: Altan Khan is building a city with temples on the steppe - Hohhot, the "Blue City". Chinese refugees are ploughing the land there.
news.n_mng_horse_markets: Peace with the Ming: Altan Khan has received the title "Prince Shunyi", and horse markets have opened on the border. Horses go for silk and tea.
news.n_mng_moscow_burned: The Crimean khan Devlet Giray has burned Moscow. They say only the Kremlin survived.
news.n_mng_tumen_khan: Tümen Jasaghtu Khan has gathered the nobles in assembly and issued a new code of laws for all the Mongols.
news.n_mng_abtai: Abtai Khan of the Khalkha has visited the Dalai Lama and received a title. He promises to build a monastery on the Orkhon.
news.n_mng_altan_death: Altan Khan, who brought the Mongols to the Yellow Faith, has died. His widow Jönggen Khatun rules the Tümed.
news.n_mng_yermak: They say the Russian Cossack Yermak and his band have taken Isker, capital of the Khanate of Sibir, beyond the Urals.
news.n_mng_dalai_death: The third Dalai Lama, Sonam Gyatso, has died on the Mongolian steppe, where he had come to preach.
news.n_mng_fourth_dalai: A boy from Altan Khan's own family has been recognised as the new Dalai Lama. The Mongols rejoice: the Buddha has come to them.
news.n_mng_imjin: They say the Japanese general Hideyoshi has landed in Korea with an enormous army and is marching on China.
news.n_mng_kanjur: They say the lamas are translating Tibetan books into Mongol - the Kangyur, a hundred and eight volumes of the Buddha's words.
news.n_mng_imjin_end: The Japanese have left Korea: Hideyoshi is dead, and Korean turtle ships have sunk their fleet.
news.n_mng_jurchen: From the east they say the Jurchen chief Nurhaci is gathering the tribes and has devised a script for them on the Mongol model.
